title: Patient Performance and Acceptance of Virtual Reality Visual Field Devices
brief_summary: The purpose of this research is to study the effectiveness and patient experience when measuring visual fields using virtual reality goggles.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any patient \>13 years old at Bascom Palmer Eye Institute
* Patients who either have glaucoma, are glaucoma suspects, or have a strong family history of glaucoma

Exclusion Criteria:

* Adults unable to consent, pregnant women, prisoners
* Patients under the age of 13
condition: Visual Field Defect, Paracentral Scotoma of Both Eyes
